turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm hosting a game night Friday. There'll be six of us, and two have never really played board games.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fun! Do you want one easy party game everyone can join, or two smaller groups playing different games?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One sec, I'm going to talk with my neighbor. Please wait until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Grace, is it just me or is the bus really late today?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's not just you. The sign says twelve minutes now.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It said five minutes when we got here.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Probably the roadwork on the main street again.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should we just walk? It's like fifteen minutes.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: In this rain? Let's give it five more minutes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fine. But if it's not here by then, I'm walking.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, that took a while. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. You were deciding between one party game and two smaller groups.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Two groups. My usual crowd will want something heavier.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Makes sense. Give the newcomers a simple card game and let the others tackle the long strategy one.
